open-legal-chile.description: Open Legal Chile: 88 herramientas MCP de derecho chileno (BCN, CGR, DT, PJUD, SII, CMF, SMA, TDLC, CNE, Panel de Expertos, Baremo Daño Moral, doctrina, grafo y OCR). Requiere `pip install openlegal-chile`; sin instalar, usar command "uvx" con args ["--from", "openlegal-chile", "openlegal-mcp"].
